# Pull request

## User problem

What reproducible problem does this change solve?

## Scope

- [ ] The change stays within the repository contract.
- [ ] No silent data repair, upload, persistence, or unimplemented Agent claim was added.
- [ ] Public behavior is documented in English and Chinese when needed.

## Verification

List exact commands and hosted checks. For HTML changes, include 375, 768,
1024, and 1440 pixel browser evidence and note the ui-ux-pro-max review.

## Risk and recovery

Describe privacy, security, compatibility, dependency, or rollback impact.
